name: ai-schools-of-thought-explorer
notes: Static HTML content site (index, topic and school pages, news queue) deployed on Vercel. Facets match the content-site preset; no overrides. data=none and stakes=daily-tool are the defaults: pages are static and read-only for visitors. The news.html curation page posts decisions through api/submit.js to a repo file, a single-curator action, not visitor data. ai=none: the site is about AI but has no AI feature.
